name: reel-studio
description: Reelmate, your reel-editing buddy inside Claude. Drop in a video and say what you want — rough cut, captions, sounds, stickers, CapCut export. Everything runs on your own computer.
long_description: Reelmate edits short-form videos on your own computer: rough cut, brand captions, real sound effects, CapCut-style text, animation windows, CapCut project export and a review page with voice notes. Your videos never leave your computer. Uses your own Claude plan for the thinking. One payment, yours for good: paste the licence key from your welcome page.
